plugins_comment: pnpm does not flatten @stryker-mutator/* packages next to @stryker-mutator/core (each lives in its own .pnpm/ tree), so Stryker's implicit plugin auto-discovery ('modules should be installed right next to stryker') cannot find vitest-runner. Without this explicit list, `stryker run` fails immediately with 'Cannot find TestRunner plugin "vitest"'. Verified locally against pnpm 11.5.2.
mutate_comment: src/image/pipeline.ts (normalize + compose) is deliberately excluded. Its mozjpeg round-trip tests take 10-14s each on this machine (tests/image/pipeline.test.ts, tests/image/compose.test.ts) and cover most of the file's statements, so most mutants there would force multi-second reruns; a 90-line file with that profile can turn a minutes-long mutation run into one that silently takes tens of minutes on a slower CI runner. It already carries 13 direct unit/boundary tests and the >=90% line-coverage gate from `pnpm test:coverage`. See task-14-15-report.md for the full rationale; if mutation coverage of this file is wanted later, give it its own scoped Stryker run outside the main CI gate.
